name: aircraft_engine_diffuser
title: Aircraft-engine diffuser exercise
summary: Steady flow of dry air through an aircraft-engine diffuser. The equation window sets the inlet at 10 °C and 80 kPa, 200 m/s, area 0.4 m²; the exit velocity is neglected and the exit pressure is atmospheric. The model computes the mass flow and the exit temperature from the steady-flow energy balance. ULiège MECA0002 exercise, 2022-2023.
